def get_components(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    components = []
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 3 and not visited[r][c]:
                comp = []
                stack = [(r, c)]
                visited[r][c] = True
                while stack:
                    cr, cc = stack.pop()
                    comp.append((cr, cc))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == 3 and not visited[nr][nc]:
                            visited[nr][nc] = True
                            stack.append((nr, nc))
                components.append(comp)
    return components

components = get_components(grid)
print(f"Number of connected components of 3s: {len(components)}")
for i, comp in enumerate(components):
    print(f"Component {i}: {len(comp)} cells, positions: {comp[:10]}{'...' if len(comp) > 10 else ''}")
    # Check if component touches border
    touches_border = any((r == 0 or r == len(grid)-1 or c == 0 or c == len(grid[0])-1) for r, c in comp)

    for c in [0, cols-1]:
